profile.headline: Advisor, AI Solutions Engineer at Mercedes-Benz USA
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing and delivering scalable backend systems — and, more recently, building agentic AI tools that automate real engineering work.
 
At Visa, I was a technical owner for high-availability payment systems processing millions of transactions: resolving critical production issues with a ~2-hour median resolution time, recovering $1.6M+ in blocked client payments, and leading a 3.6M-account data migration. I designed LDAPAuthLibrary, a reusable authentication library, and built the TechOps Workflow — a 9-stage agentic plugin that takes a Jira ticket from investigation through root-cause analysis, fix, and automated pull request.
 
I enjoy problems at the intersection of reliability and automation, and I'm looking for my next role in backend engineering or AI/GenAI-focused engineering. Open to connecting.

US Citizen, No Sponsorship Required

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and built the TechOps Workflow, an end-to-end 9-stage agentic AI plugin that automates a Jira ticket's full lifecycle — investigation, root-cause analysis, fix, automated pull request, QA, and security scans; also delivered a Splunk MCP server, DB MCP server, ClickHouse MCP server, and Claude Agent API integration to advance team-wide GenAI adoption.
 
Designed and built LDAPAuthLibrary, a reusable Spring Boot LDAP authentication/authorization library, enabling rapid compliance with Visa's cybersecurity policy and zero security incidents across integrating applications.
 
Served as technical owner for high-availability payment systems, resolving Critical and High-severity production issues with a ~2-hour median resolution time (100% same-day on Criticals); recovered $1.6M+ in blocked client payments and led a 3.6M-account data migration to improve system reliability.
 
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, automating code quality and security checks (Checkmarx, Sonatype, SonarQube) and remediating AI-SAST and container vulnerability findings across four production systems — closing all items within Required Resolution Dates.
 
Deployed and managed containerized applications (Docker/Kubernetes) as part of a resilient, maintainable production infrastructure supporting 99.99%+ availability targets.
 
Owned full software development lifecycle — from requirements through design, testing, security assessment, and production deployment — while providing hands-on production support and cross-functional collaboration with product, PRE, and client services teams.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Back-End Development: Architect and implement scalable microservices with Spring Boot, integrating Microsoft SQL, PostgreSQL, Amazon S3, RabbitMQ, Vault, and JFrog Artifactory to support data-driven applications.
- API Development: Develop and maintain RESTful APIs to manage and transport complex Data Transfer Objects (DTOs).
- CI/CD & DevOps: Build and deploy services using CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, Maven, Artifactory, SonarQube, and Pivotal Cloud Foundry to ensure high-quality and secure releases.
- Containerization & Orchestration: Utilize Docker for containerization and Kubernetes for orchestration in a production-grade environment.
- Front-End Integration: Collaborate on full-stack development efforts using Angular, implementing dynamic, user-friendly front-end features that interface seamlessly with back-end services.

positions.description: Web App Development intern in Finance and Accounting department.
